_howto: Add one object per game. 'play' is a folder inside games/ (e.g. games/my-game/) or a full URL. Leave 'play' empty for projects without a web build; they show in the archive with a source link.

featured.title: Card School
featured.description: Learn to play cards from zero. Ten short levels go from suits and card order to tricks and trump, then full games of Call Bridge and 29 against computer players. Each trick explains who won and why, with animations, music and sound effects.
featured.controls: Tap or click a card to play it. Cards you're allowed to play lift up and glow.

featured.title: Dhaka Metaverse
featured.description: A 3D driving game on the real road network of central Dhaka. Five modes (ride share, delivery rush, checkpoint sprint, free drive, circuit race against rival cars with different power), traffic that gives way when you honk, crash effects, and music from your own songs, internet radio or YouTube.
featured.controls: W/S drive, A/D steer, Shift nitro, H horn, T back on the road. Touch controls on phones.
